voxelPromptZh: 一个带前向镜头、握柄和顶部取景框的箱形相机。 采用彩色体素。坐标为0至47的整数，X左右、Y向上、Z前后；实际接地最低Y为0。占用750至1250个唯一体素，RGB为0至255整数；保持单一六邻域连通、真实开口及面连接。不要添加展示底板、文字、背景、噪声或悬浮装饰。
voxelPromptEn: A box camera with a forward lens, grip and top viewfinder. Use colored voxels at unique integer coordinates from 0 through 47, with X left to right, Y upward and Z front to back. Real ground contact starts at Y zero. Use 750 through 1250 occupied voxels and integer RGB values from 0 through 255. Keep one six neighbor component, real openings and face connected parts. Add no display base, text, background, noise or floating ornaments.
